# Glossary

| Term | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Token | A model input or output unit; often a word piece rather than a full word. |
| Context window | The amount of input and output a model can consider in one request. |
| Grounding | Constraining model answers to provided or retrieved evidence. |
| RAG | Retrieval-augmented generation: retrieve sources, then generate grounded output. |
| JSON Schema | A machine-readable contract for JSON structure and field validation. |
| Tool use | A model selecting and calling an external capability through a defined interface. |
| Prompt injection | A malicious or accidental instruction that tries to override trusted instructions. |
| Evaluation | A repeatable method for deciding whether a prompt or model output meets success criteria. |
